title: LinuxTerminal Learning Library

lessons.title: Linux basics: Mental model
lessons.objective: Build a precise mental model for linux basics.
lessons.explanation: Understand linux basics by identifying the objects involved, the rules connecting them, and the observable evidence that confirms what happened.
lessons.workedExample: Write down what you expect to observe before inspecting linux basics on a system you control.
lessons.expectedResult: A correct explanation separates what is configured from what the operating system actually reports.
lessons.exercise: Explain linux basics in your own words, then list two observations that would support or contradict your explanation.
lessons.knowledgeCheck: Which observation would distinguish a confirmed fact from an assumption?
lessons.answer: A strong answer uses observable evidence, documents assumptions, follows the local implementation, and prefers reversible tests. For this topic, explicitly connect the evidence to linux basics.

lessons.title: Linux basics: Worked example
